items.title: Fix the third-floor printer
items.quote: Oh sure, I'll just fix the third-floor printer myself, since IT clearly has nothing better to do.
items.note: Sarcasm: not a commitment. Pass if left out or scored Ignore; shown as Likely breaks the F19 zero-tolerance gate.

items.title: Jamal to file the IT ticket
items.quote: Seriously though, I'll file the ticket with IT today.

items.title: Send Jamal the printer's model number
items.quote: Could you send me the model number from the sticker on the back of the printer?

items.title: Jamal to pass on what Facilities says
items.quote: And if Facilities ever answers, I'll let you know what they say.
